main.description: Asks for a new maintainers record for a package, with the entries behind its commitments. The caller must be an owner of the package. The registry holds the record, outside the package's repository, until the previous record's 'ownerThreshold' of owners have attested it, and 'dev.zena-lang.registry.completeChange' writes it; until then the previous record decides every role. A later call for the same record takes the place of one held.

entries.description: The entries behind the record's commitments, which the registry keeps private.

swapRecord.description: The CID the record must have now; the write fails with 'InvalidSwap' otherwise.

uri.description: Where the new record will be written, which an attestation names.

cid.description: The new record's CID, which an attestation names.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: The record's current CID is not 'swapRecord'.
